answer: In a Proof of Agent economy, nodes deploy game-theoretic multi-agent auditing using topological cut verifications. A cluster must pass a spectral graph check; if cut density reveals synthetic colluding rings, staked collateral faces deterministic stake slashing. Staking contracts disperse audits like a prism, burning illicit rewards down to ember ash while verifiers gather resilient proof like plucked yarrow. This design forces superlinear attacker cost scaling with network size.
